</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>走为上</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(zǒu wéi shàng)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>If All Else Fails, Retreat</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
Attempting to unify China, Zhuge Liang of Shu made six forays against
the more powerful State of Wei. Although none were successful, he
managed each time to bring his 100,000 (or so) troops out via the
steep Qinling Mountains without sustaining significant losses. One of
the methods he used to secure space for himself was to 'thrust a
spear from the rear of the horse', which involved a rapid attack
followed by an equally rapid retreat. This would leaving the enemy
forces uncertain of what was happening thereby giving Liang time
enough to get away [7], [15], [18].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">I</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">f</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">
All Else Fails, Retreat</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 33rd hexagram, <i>Heaven
over Mountain</i>. The
yin lines represent an opponent rising up, and the yang lines
represent the sustained contact necessary for making a successful
retreat, which often still involves making some anticipatory
counterattacks [1],
[28].</span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section88" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;">

	first chairman of the People's Republic of China was Mao Zedong.</span></span></p>

	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: In 1963, the

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

    3) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> <span style="font-family: times;">所有的外交人员都撤走了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

    4) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> 他是我的上级，我应该听他的。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">把空调风关小一点可以吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">土耳其的总理是 Tayyip

	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她很喜欢星球大战的系列电影。</span></span></span></p>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) 2008<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">年的奥运会在中国。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他们要打冰球，但是没有球。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请你把音响开大一点。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-target-text22"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我要</span></span></span><span lang="zh-CN">刮</span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">胡子，但是这里没有镜子。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他两年以内能毕业。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我把被子叠起来了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">折叠自行车不许带上地铁。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这里没有公共洗手间。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	16) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">想要在那里上学的话，要求会基本的中</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;文。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    17) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">这是最上等的红葡萄酒。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-target-text24"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    18) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我的小孩一直都说这个规则不公平。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	19) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">关于我们的目标，我很疑惑。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	20) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这件事的影响很大。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">
    21) </span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">你不应该把包留在车上。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br /></p>
